content.summary: A transit planner crosses solid icons, circle wipe, paper tiles and luminous rail symbols. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity stays registered through all media changes. + A shared geometry motivates every transition. + Each stage changes one medium property only. + Composition remains matchable before and after the wipe. + The final title restores all identity and geometry anchors.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult animated transit planner between a coral left arrow and a cobalt up arrow on a clean station plaza. Keep her silver bob, green coat and square badge registered as the icons enlarge. Resolve those tiles into luminous rail-line symbols and hold the exact title NEXT PLATFORM around the same planner.
required_anchors: One adult identity stays registered through all media changes.
A shared geometry motivates every transition.
Composition remains matchable before and after the wipe.
The final title restores all identity and geometry anchors.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A transit planner crosses solid icons, circle wipe, paper tiles and luminous rail symbols. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
